lines.zh: 挥舞斧头前行，声响震颤四方。
lines.en: Wield the axe, rattle the surroundings.
The necropolis king moves heavily.
Swing the sword, step by step.
Sharpen the blade at dusk.
Swing the axe, echo through the woods.
Step with determination, filled with killing intent.
Axe swings, the air trembles.
Releasing chill as it walks.
Heavy footsteps.
Swing the axe, killing intent rises.
Stand still, gaze around.
Wield the axe, making buzzing sounds.
Swing the sword, echoes ringing.
Swing both axes, hoarse voice.
Swing the axe to test, deep voice.
Swing both axes, hollow echo.
Wield the long axe, dull sound.
Wield the axe, deep sound.
Swing the sword, dull echo.
Swing both axes, deep voice

lines.zh: 它把斧刃在灰烬里蹭亮。
lines.en: It polishes the axe edge on the ash.

lines.zh: 它数着腰间挂着的头颅。
lines.en: It counts the skulls hanging at its belt.
It pulls its hood a little lower.

lines.zh: 斧柄敲着地面，一下又一下。
lines.en: The haft taps the ground, again and again.

lines.zh: 它盯着灰烬里将熄的火。
lines.en: It watches a fire dying in the ash.
It wipes black blood off the blade.
Notice you, sharp gaze.
Stare at you, chilling intent.
Gaze like a knife, fixing you.
Notice you, swing the sword.
Fix you, chill pouring out.
Gaze like a torch, aiming at you.
Fix you, chilling intent.
Notice you, swing the axe.
Gaze like lightning, fixing you.

lines.zh: 它抬起头，露出空洞的眼。
lines.en: It raises its head and shows hollow eyes.

lines.zh: 它用斧尖指你，又指自己的脖子。
lines.en: It points the axe at you, then at its own neck.

lines.zh: 它的目光扫过你，像在量尺寸。
lines.en: Its gaze passes over you like a measurement.

lines.zh: 黯淡的斧光划过你的身体。
lines.en: Dim light slashes across your body.
Cold sweat soaks through your armor.

lines.zh: 你感到一股寒意在体内蔓延。
lines.en: A chill runs through your body.
Your bones tremble.
The axe slices through your flesh.
You fly back, hitting the ground.
You struggle to your feet.
Your body contorts in pain.
Your wounds bleed.
You feel weak, struggling to stay upright.

lines.zh: 你散发出的光芒让他憎恶。
lines.en: The light you emit disgusts it.

lines.zh: 靠近我，你会得到死亡的礼物。
lines.en: Approach me, and you'll receive a death gift.
My axe is hungry. Feed it first.

lines.zh: 放弃抵抗，享受我的斧头。
lines.en: Give in, enjoy my axe.

lines.zh: 你那微不足道的火焰对我无用。
lines.en: Your insignificant flame is useless to me.
Feel the chill of my axe.

lines.zh: 你走近一步，斧头就抬一寸。
lines.en: Each step you take, my axe rises an inch.
Your strength doesn't affect me.
Drop the gold in your hand and go.

lines.zh: 我只需你的头颅作为纪念。
lines.en: I only need your head as a trophy.
You disrupted my vision.
I end you with my axe.
Your collision angers me.
I respond with force.
Our collision sparks.
I won't easily forgive.
Move aside; my axe knows no names.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸吵到我的斧头。
lines.en: Your breathing offends my axe.
I split you with my axe.
Our collision is inevitable.
This is my territory, get out.
You interfere with my rule.
What do you want, Undead?
My queen needs you.
You can't challenge my position.
Are you here to help me?
My will is unbreakable.

lines.zh: 你的存在是对我的侮辱。
lines.en: Your presence is an insult.
I'm the lord of this forest.
Submit to me, or I'll kill you.

lines.zh: 听到脚步声，亡灵王转过头来。
lines.en: The skull turns towards the sound.

lines.zh: 它盯着你，眼中闪烁着寒光。
lines.en: Its eyes gleam with cold hatred.

lines.zh: 头盔下露出锋利的牙齿。
lines.en: Sharp teeth peek from beneath the helmet.

lines.zh: 挥舞斧头，发出沉重的劈砍声。
lines.en: Swinging the axe, a heavy hacking sound.
It growls, threatening you.

lines.zh: 亡灵王的双眼如同夜空中的星辰。
lines.en: Its eyes are stars in the night sky.

lines.zh: 它对音乐毫无兴趣，只在乎你。
lines.en: It shows no interest in music, only you.
It hisses, closing the distance.

lines.zh: 斧头在月光下反射出寒光。
lines.en: The axe gleams in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 亡灵王的呼吸声充满杀气。
lines.en: Its breath is laced with malice.
It notices your movements.

lines.zh: 它盯上了你，眼睛里露出贪婪。
lines.en: Its eyes gleam with greed.
It starts tracking your movements.
It fixes its gaze on you, unyielding.

lines.zh: 你的一举一动都逃不过它的法眼。
lines.en: Your every move is under its watch.

lines.zh: 它瞄准你，眼神变得炽热。
lines.en: It aims at you, its gaze blazing.

lines.zh: 它开始计算攻击的最佳时机。
lines.en: It calculates the best moment to attack.

lines.zh: 它对你的威胁越来越敏感。
lines.en: It becomes increasingly sensitive to your threat.

lines.zh: 亡灵之王的斧，抬起来了。
lines.en: The undead king's axe comes up.
It seeks an opportunity to attack.

lines.zh: 我要看你在灰烬里跪下。
lines.en: I want to see you kneel in the ash.

lines.zh: 我把你的名字刻在斧柄上。
lines.en: I carve your name into the haft.
This forest answers to me.

lines.zh: 我的斧头已经等你很久。
lines.en: My axe has waited a long time for you.

lines.zh: 我会把你的头挂在腰上。
lines.en: I will hang your head at my belt.

lines.zh: 你逃走的样子，我很想看。
lines.en: I would like to see you try to run.

lines.zh: 跪下，我就让你死得快点。
lines.en: Kneel, and I will make it quick.

lines.zh: 我的名单上，又添了一个。
lines.en: My list has gained one more name.

lines.zh: 它手中的斧头准备就绪。
lines.en: Its axe is ready.

lines.zh: 它的眼神中充满了杀气。
lines.en: Its eyes are full of malice.

lines.zh: 斧头在它手中显得沉重而有力。
lines.en: The axe feels heavy and powerful in its hands.

lines.zh: 它准备好了，只等你送上门来。
lines.en: It's ready, waiting for you to come to it.
Its breath quickens.

lines.zh: 它的肌肉紧绷，准备发起攻击。
lines.en: Its muscles tense, preparing to attack.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛在夜色中闪烁着寒光。
lines.en: Its eyes gleam in the night.

lines.zh: 它的斧头在月光下闪烁着寒光。
lines.en: Its axe gleams in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 它的动作变得迅猛而有力。
lines.en: Its movements are swift and powerful.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛紧盯着你的弱点。
lines.en: Its eyes fix on your weak points.
I raise the axe past my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我量好你脖子到斧刃的距离。
lines.en: I measure the gap from your neck to my edge.

lines.zh: 我的脚跟扎进灰里，稳住下盘。
lines.en: I plant my heels in the ash.
I have practiced this swing for a thousand years.
I turn my shoulder and bring the edge to you.

lines.zh: 斧刃上的灰，我一层层磨掉。
lines.en: I grind the ash off my axe edge, layer by layer.

lines.zh: 我的影子先压到你脚边。
lines.en: My shadow reaches your feet first.

lines.zh: 我把兜帽压低，遮住斧光。
lines.en: I lower my hood to hide the axe's gleam.

lines.zh: 我的指节在斧柄上收紧。
lines.en: My knuckles tighten on the haft.
The axe is not fast, but it never misses.
Swing the axe at the enemy!
Sawing bones wildly, full of killing intent!
Swinging the sword with no mercy!
The King of the Ash Forest!
Falling axe, life extinguished!
Cut the enemy's lifeline!
Waving the death axe!
Wrath of the undead, pouring out!
Slicing the enemy's throat!
Smashing the enemy's head with an axe!
The axe falls, scattering ash.
One stroke splits your shield.

lines.zh: 我横过斧身，把你扫出去。
lines.en: I sweep the haft across and send you flying.
The flat of the axe lands; bones crack first.
Suddenly appears in the Ash Forest!
Born in the Ash Forest at night!
The King of the Undead descends!
Awakens slowly from the ashes!
Guardian of the Ash Forest!
Legendary beast of the Ash Forest!
Undead crawling out of the abyss!
King of the Undead in the ashes!
Dark legend of the Ash Forest!

lines.zh: 黑暗中浮现的亡灵之王！
lines.en: King of the Undead emerging from darkness!

lines.zh: 灰烬堆里站起一具戴兜帽的尸。
lines.en: A hooded corpse rises from the ash heap.
The forest falls quiet; it has come.

lines.zh: 我的斧头先于身体出现在雾里。
lines.en: My axe shows through the fog before my body does.

lines.zh: 传说野兽的脚步声压过树叶。
lines.en: The legendary beast's steps drown out the leaves.

lines.zh: 我从烧尽的林子里走出来。
lines.en: I walk out of the burned grove.

lines.zh: 灰烬打着旋，围成一具王座。
lines.en: Ash spirals into the shape of a throne.

lines.zh: 亡灵之王的兜帽下亮起火光。
lines.en: Fire brightens under the undead king's hood.

lines.zh: 它踩着别人的头骨走过来。
lines.en: It walks over someone's skull.

lines.zh: 这片灰地，添了一位行刑官。
lines.en: This ashen ground gains an executioner.
Three taps of the axe, and I arrive.

lines.zh: 火舔过我的兜帽，我不躲。
lines.en: Fire licks my hood; I don't flinch.

lines.zh: 你摔落在冰冷的地面上。
lines.en: You fall on the cold ground.
You are swallowed by icy water.

lines.zh: 冲击波震得你五脏六腑翻腾。
lines.en: The shockwave rattles your insides.
An arrow pierces your chest.

lines.zh: 寒冰魔法冻结你的血液。
lines.en: Ice magic freezes your blood.
Hunger eats away at your body.
Lightning strikes your spine.

lines.zh: 虚空的黑暗侵蚀你的生命。
lines.en: Void's darkness drains your life.
